changeSet.author: tgms
changeSet.comment: Replace Material Supply fake-delete DISCONTINUED rows with safe CRUD deletion while preserving Inventory-linked supplies as INACTIVE historical source records. This destructive legacy cleanup is forward-only and intentionally has no rollback because deleted or converted data cannot be reconstructed.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM material_supplies WHERE status = 'DISCONTINUED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_materials im WHERE im.source_material_supply_id = material_supplies.id )
ALTER TABLE material_supplies DROP CHECK ck_material_supplies_status
ALTER TABLE material_supplies DROP CONSTRAINT ck_material_supplies_status
ALTER TABLE material_supplies ADD CONSTRAINT ck_material_supplies_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
